title: Amazing Grace

nodes.title: Amazing Grace
nodes.body: A slow tune in D, and a first song for both hands. Sing it through, then play the line as it is sung, not as separate notes. Breathe where the line ends. A breath in the middle of the line is the remark. The high D, when it comes, is the octave. The words are not a score.

source: John Newton, melody New Britain, public domain. Setting written for this pack, in D, with a breath at the end of the line.
